story_type: cruise ship medevac by cutter, crews in protective suits, March 2020
hook: Before she could leave this cruise ship, the CDC had to weigh in.
narration: Before this woman could leave her cruise ship, the CDC had to weigh in.
It was March 2020, and the ship was the Grand Princess.
A passenger in her mid seventies had a medical problem that was not related to COVID nineteen.
Coast Guard watchstanders call the duty flight surgeon, a doctor on call, to decide whether a patient at sea needs to come off. This time they called the CDC too.
Crews in protective suits moved her and her husband from the ship's launch onto Coast Guard Cutter Tern.
Then the Tern ran for shore.
outcome: The Tern crew delivered her and her husband to waiting EMS at Coast Guard Sector San Francisco.
title: Off the Grand Princess, March 2020
description:
On March 7, 2020, Coast Guard Cutter Tern crew members medevaced a Grand Princess passenger in her mid-70s, whose medical condition was not related to COVID-19, and her husband to EMS personnel at Coast Guard Sector San Francisco. Watchstanders consulted the duty flight surgeon and the CDC first.
